reviews.review: I'm really impressed with this game developer. Every time they produce a new game they are some new improvements made or a totally new puzzle introduced. I already love the locked box puzzle, I'm struggling with the new puzzle, sliding shapes, still doable but I'm slowly warming up to it. All the puzzles are doable it's game play is something to while your stress away. The fact that you can switch and play in another language is an added bonus. I've played in both English & Dutch (Netherlands). The artwork illustration renderings are beautiful and especially for the hidden object games the attention to details are superb. They have put a lot of thought in the game. Also like the subtle 2D movement effect when you've completed a hidden object puzzle. I hope they will continue producing these games for every season of the year.
